decisions.name: Use persistent desktop shell
decisions.description: Candidate decision inferred from the reference: persistent left navigation with workspace content on the right.
decisions.decision: Keep navigation persistently visible on the desktop reference breakpoint.
decisions.rationale: The supplied screen dedicates a stable left rail to navigation and user context.

decisions.name: Use status-driven Kanban columns
decisions.description: Candidate decision inferred from the reference: four lifecycle columns.
decisions.decision: Organize tasks into Not Started, Pending, Completed and Under Review columns.
decisions.rationale: The visual hierarchy and colored column labels treat lifecycle status as the board's primary grouping dimension.

decisions.name: Share Badge for status and priority
decisions.description: Status and priority labels use one Badge component with semantic variants/tokens.
decisions.decision: Use a single Badge component for workflow status and task priority labels; semantic meaning is expressed by property values and token bindings.
decisions.rationale: Human review confirmed shared component semantics for the reference system.
mustNotChange: Do not create separate visual Badge components solely for Status versus Priority without a new reviewed requirement.

decisions.name: Keep Kanban Column as pattern
decisions.description: Kanban Column is not forced into a publishable component in the first implementation slice.
decisions.decision: Treat Kanban Column as a pattern/composition in the first slice rather than publishing it as a standalone component.
decisions.rationale: Human review preferred avoiding an unnecessary component abstraction.
mustNotChange: Do not create a standalone Kanban Column component solely to mirror the screenshot.

decisions.name: Tilted Task Card is a drag state
decisions.description: The tilted Pending task card is treated as a transient drag/dynamic state, not a permanent variant.
decisions.decision: Do not create a permanent rotated Task Card variant; treat the tilted card as a transient drag/dynamic presentation state.
decisions.rationale: Human review confirmed the tilt is behavioral/transient rather than a distinct design variant.
mustNotChange: Do not add a Rotated variant solely to reproduce the reference snapshot.

decisions.name: Tablet adaptation strategy
decisions.description: Approved responsive strategy for the Tasklify dashboard tablet test case.
decisions.decision: For tablet widths 768–1023px, use an 834×1112 test viewport, collapse the 187px sidebar to an approximately 72px icon rail, reflow KPI cards to a 2×2 grid, preserve readable Kanban card/column widths with horizontal board scrolling, and keep the primary top-bar action visible without wrapping the control group.
decisions.rationale: This preserves information hierarchy and task-card readability while testing a tablet adaptation suitable for later Changshu admin use.
mustNotChange: Do not squeeze all four Kanban columns into the tablet viewport at unreadable widths.
Do not remove the primary Create Task action solely because of tablet width.
Do not replace the persistent desktop shell with an unrelated mobile navigation pattern in this tablet range.
